parts.text: $CVX: operating profit grew faster than sales, +152% vs +36% for Q3 2026. Revenue reached $67.8B with a 20.1% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #oil
$SRE: about 35¢ of every revenue dollar is operating profit, up from 20¢ a year ago. Q3 revenue $3.2B (+1% Y/Y). (preliminary) 👇 #earnings #utilities
$HTZ: sold more but kept less — revenue +6% to $2.6B, but operating profit fell 63% as costs outpaced sales. 👇 #earnings #EarningsSeason
$NSIT: sold more but kept less — revenue +22% to $2.4B, operating profit −26% (preliminary). Q3 costs grew faster than sales. 👇 #earnings #ecommerce
$SO (preliminary): non-fuel revenue drove 68% of the quarterly gain, rising 16% Y/Y. Q3 revenue $8.8B (+13%) with a 33.9% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #utilities
$MTB: cash came in ahead of profit — operating cash flow $1.3B, 162% of net earnings. Q3 revenue $2.5B (+1% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #banks
$ZTS: about 30¢ of every revenue dollar is operating profit, down from 37¢ a year ago. Q3 revenue $2.4B (−1% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #pharma
$ARKO: sold more but kept less — revenue +18% to $2.4B, but operating profit fell 2% to a 1.5% margin. Costs grew 19%. 👇 #earnings #retail
$JONES FINANCIAL: fee revenue drove 102% of the growth — Q3 revenue $5.2B (+13% Y/Y), led by advisory programs. 👇 #earnings #finance
$GOLD: revenue −11% to $3.3B (preliminary), but gross profit rose 23% and net income hit $1.6M. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$ROK: sold more but kept less — revenue +1% to $2.3B, operating margin 18.6% (preliminary). Q4 software & control led growth up 15%. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$ONCOR: profit is growing faster than sales — operating profit +44% vs revenue +24% in Q3 2026 (preliminary). Revenue hit $2.3B with a 34.6% margin. 👇 #earnings #utilities
